content.summary: The envoys pay court (拜朝) in the third month of 天平勝寶四年, before the 節刀 grant of the following leap month. The entry names no place; the record anchors the act at the court's seat, 平城宮, as a display anchor.

time.source_expression: 天平勝寶四年三月庚辰

content.editorial_notes: The entry names the envoys collectively (遣唐使等); the participant list follows the appointment entries and is not an independent naming in this entry.

places.note: The entry names no place. A court act happens at the court, whose seat in this period is 平城宮 (the palace of 平城京); the record anchors it there for display only, not as a source-named site, and asserts no site for the act.
